stem: Simplify the following expression to a single rational expression. $\dfrac{{=p}+\dfrac{1}{x}}{{=q}+\dfrac{1}{x}}$
solution: The only small fraction is $\frac{1}{x}$, so multiply the top and the bottom by $x$.
notes: Basic: a single inner fraction 1/x, multiply top and bottom by x. p,q in 2..6 distinct, so no common factor and no coefficient 1; answer is already in lowest terms.
